title: Request for Information - USAFA Utility Terrain Vehicle and All-Terrain Vehicle Service and Repair
agency_path: DEPT OF DEFENSE.DEPT OF THE AIR FORCE.U.S. AIR FORCE ACADEMY.FA7000  10 CONS LGC
detail_text: This is a request for information for an upcoming requirement to perform service and repair of Utility Terrain Vehicles and All-Terrain Vehicles throughout the United States Air Force Academy. Formal quotes are not being requested at this time. This is strictly for market research purposes only. *Note: The previous associated Notice ID was FA700025Q0128 which has been updated to FA700026Q0036. **Update 0001: Incorporates Attch 3 - Price List_ATV-UTV_14Apr26.
